title: Payroll Assistant
company: Bennett and Game Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £28000 - £32000 per year (Full time or Part time)
description:
Our client is a well-established and growing accountancy practice based in the Preston area, providing accountancy, taxation, payroll and business advisory services to a varied client base. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit a Payroll Assistant to join their existing team.

This is initially a part-time role working three days per week, with the potential to increase to five days for candidates who can also assist with accounts preparation and VAT returns.

Role Overview - Payroll Assistant
- Assist with weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Accurately process payroll data including hours, salary changes, overtime, bonuses, deductions, starters and leavers.
- Support RTI submissions, pension administration and other payroll-related filings.
- Prepare draft payslips, reports and payroll summaries for review.
- Respond to client and employee payroll queries professionally and promptly.
- Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records.
- Assist with year-end processes, including P60s.
- Liaise with HMRC, pension providers and clients where required.
- Provide general administrative support to the payroll team.
- Where experience allows, assist with accounts preparation and VAT returns, with the potential to increase working days to five per week.

Role Requirements - Skills & Experience
- Previous payroll, payroll bureau, bookkeeping, accounts or relevant administrative experience.
- Experience processing payroll for multiple clients is advantageous.
- Accounts preparation and VAT experience is desirable due to the potential for additional working days.
- PayCircle or similar payroll software experience would be advantageous.
- Good understanding of confidentiality and data protection.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary: 28,000 - 32,000 pro rata, depending on experience.
- Hours: Three days per week initially, with potential for five days.
- Holiday: 20 days pro rata.
- Training: Support available for further relevant training and development.
- Opportunity to develop within a growing accountancy practice with exposure to both payroll and wider accounts work.
- Pension

Bennett and Game Recruitment are a multi-disciplined technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex operating across the UK with specialist teams covering a range of industries.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an established automotive business for a Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator to join its busy team in Bolton.

This is a varied role combining accounts administration, sales ledger and service department support. It would suit someone with experience in accounts or motor retail, particularly within a service department, who enjoys working with figures, coordinating administrative processes and delivering excellent customer service.

You will play a key role in ensuring service jobs are administered efficiently, invoices are raised accurately and customers receive a professional, responsive service.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts & Invoicing
- Raising and processing customer invoices for servicing, repairs and maintenance work.
- Checking job cards, labour hours, parts used and associated costs to ensure accurate invoicing.
- Maintaining sales ledger records and ensuring customer accounts are kept up to date.
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies and account queries.
- Allocating payments, assisting with account reconciliations and supporting credit control activities.
- Monitoring completed jobs awaiting invoicing to ensure work is billed promptly.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end procedures.

Service Administration
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Service Department.
- Processing service documentation, job cards, work orders and associated paperwork.
- Supporting Service Advisors with vehicle bookings, service records and customer updates where required.
- Liaising with workshop technicians, parts departments and service colleagues to ensure job information is complete.
- Coordinating paperwork for servicing, repairs, maintenance and warranty claims where applicable.
- Monitoring the progress of service jobs and following up on outstanding documentation.
- Responding to customer telephone and email enquiries professionally.
- Updating customer and vehicle records accurately on internal systems.
- Assisting with purchase orders, parts documentation and general service administration.
- Ensuring all completed work is documented correctly and ready for invoicing.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an accounts, sales ledger or accounts administration role in an automotive/motor retail evviornment involving service administration and invoicing
- Understanding of customer invoicing, job cards and financial documentation.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and the ability to learn new systems.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and maintaining accurate records.

Experience within a motor trade service department and familiarity with dealer management systems such as Kerridge/Autoline would be advantageous.

Working Hours

Flexible start times are available, with the option to start between 6:00am and 9:30am, working eight hours per day.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and detail-focused, with the ability to balance financial accuracy with efficient service administration. You will be comfortable liaising with customers and colleagues, managing competing priorities and ensuring service paperwork and invoicing are completed within deadlines.

What's on Offer?

Salary of £25,000 £30,000, depending on experience, flexible start times, the opportunity to join an established automotive business, a varied position combining accounts, invoicing and service administration within a supportive team environment and opportunities to develop your skills.

title: Care Navigator / Receptionist
description: We are a friendly, busy two-partner GP practice based in Penwortham and are currently looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Care Navigator to join our team. This is a key front-line role within the practice. As a Care Navigator, you will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, whether face-to-face, over the telephone, or via online communication. You will play an important role in ensuring patients receive the right care, from the right professional, at the right time, whilst providing a welcoming and professional service at all times. The successful candidate will be able to project a positive, friendly, and caring image to patients and visitors, demonstrate excellent communication skills, and thrive in a busy environment where no two days are the same. To provide an efficient and courteous reception and administrative service to patients, healthcare professionals, and visitors. The Care Navigator will assist patients in accessing the most appropriate service or clinician, ensuring appointments and enquiries are managed effectively whilst maintaining the highest standards of patient confidentiality and customer care. Previous experience of working in General Practice would be an advantage. The hours will be 16hrs per week, comprising of morning or afternoon shifts to cover surgery opening hours - between 8.00am & 6.30pm, working 3 days per week. Flexibility is a must. There may be a possibility of extra hours in the future, but this is not guaranteed. Applicant must be able to do additional hours to cover staff leave and must be able to work flexible hours. The Care Navigator/Receptionist is often the first point of contact for patients and visitors to the practice. The post holder will provide a professional, friendly, and efficient reception and administrative service, ensuring patients are directed to the most appropriate clinician or service and receive excellent customer care at all times. The role requires excellent communication skills, empathy, discretion, and the ability to work effectively in a busy environment while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism. Greet patients and visitors in a courteous and professional manner. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and effectively. Manage patient enquiries, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Book, amend, and cancel appointments in line with practice protocols. Support patients in accessing online services and NHS digital resources. Deal with requests for home visits and ensure appropriate action is taken. Signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician, healthcare professional, or external service based on their needs. Explain available services and appointment options to patients. Assist patients in accessing self-care information and community services where appropriate. Ensure urgent clinical concerns are escalated in accordance with practice procedures. Register new patients and update patient demographics. Process repeat prescription requests following practice procedures. Scan and file clinical correspondence accurately. Manage incoming and outgoing post. Action tasks and workflow requests as directed. Maintain accurate patient records using the clinical system. manage and sort accurx triage requests. Work collaboratively with GPs, nurses, administrative staff, and external healthcare professionals. Maintain confidentiality and comply with GDPR and NHS information governance requirements. Contribute to a positive and supportive team environment. Attend team meetings and training sessions as required.
